items.title: Vultrino – Let AI agents use credentials without seeing them
items.raw_excerpt:
I built Vultrino because I kept running into the same problem: I want AI agents to do things
that require credentials, but I don't want those secrets in prompts, logs, or context windows. It's not just API keys – it's signing commits with PGP keys, accessing databases, decrypting
files, anything that needs a secret. The agent shouldn't see the credential; it should just be
able to use it. Vultrino is a credential proxy that sits between your AI agent and the operation. The agent says "use my github-api credential" or "sign this with my pgp-key" and Vultrino handles the secret
material without exposing it. Key features:
- WASM plugin system – add any credential type (PGP signing plugin included, build your own)
- MCP native – works directly with Claude
- OAuth2 with automatic token refresh

items.title: AI file agents that work across your existing documents
items.raw_excerpt: See, we all know tools like ChatGPT and Claude can create files now. But something big is still missing: context. Real work does not start from scratch. It depends on existing files, past documents, logos, images, spreadsheets, and PDFs scattered across your drive. That is exactly why we built The Drive AI. The Drive AI uses file agents that do more than just generate new files. They can pull information, images, tables, and logos from your existing files and use them to create new documents like Word files, PDFs, PowerPoint decks, and Excel sheets. Would love to hear your thoughts.

items.title: Supercheck.io – Open-Source AI-Powered Test Automation and Monitoring
items.raw_excerpt:
Hi HN, We built Supercheck – an open source platform that combines test automation and uptime monitoring in one self-hosted solution. *The Problem:*
Most monitoring tools are expensive SaaS products that charge per check. Test automation and monitoring are often separate concerns, using different tools and workflows. We wanted a unified platform where you can write a Playwright test once and use it for both CI/CD testing and production monitoring and use same tool for k6 performance tests too. *What Supercheck Does:* Testing:
- Playwright browser tests (UI/E2E) with screenshots, traces, videos
- API tests (HTTP/GraphQL)
- Database tests (PostgreSQL, MySQL)
- k6 performance tests
- Schedule tests via cron or trigger from CI/CD Monitoring:
- HTTP, Website, Ping, Port monitors
- Synthetic mon

items.title: AI agent that builds web automations through conversation
items.raw_excerpt:
Text:
We previously posted Vectorly ( https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=46209538 ), our open-source app that reverse-engineers websites into reusable APIs. The core idea: instead of clicking through UIs like a human, interact with websites through their underlying HTTP endpoints. Faster, cheaper, more reliable. Building routines by recording browser sessions worked well, but refining them was still manual. So we built Guide, a conversational agent that walks you through the whole process: - Describe your task and the agent helps scope it - Record in a cloud browser, just use the site normally - Agent analyzes the session, identifies backend endpoints, extracts parameters, builds a reusable routine - Refine through chat to propose edits, review diffs, iterate without hand-editing anythin

items.title: Cursor for Userscripts
items.raw_excerpt: I’ve been experimenting with embedding an Claude Code/Cursor-style coding agent directly into the browser. At a high level, the agent generates and maintains userscripts and CSS that are re-applied on page load. Rather than just editing DOM via JS in console the agent is treating the page, and the DOM as a file. The models are often trained in RL sandboxes with full access to the filesystem and bash, so they are really good at using it. So to make the agent behave well, I've simulated this environment. The whole state of a page and scripts is implemented as a virtual filesystem hacked on top of browser.local storage. URL is mapped to directories, and the agent starts inside this directory. It has the tools to read/edit files, grep around and a fake bash command that is just used for runnin

items.title: 从复杂挑战到竞争优势：AI SQL 如何重塑非结构化数据的价值边界
items.raw_excerpt: 在生成式 AI 快速走向工程化落地的背景下，企业真正面临的挑战，已不再是有没有数据，而是如何让长期被忽视的非结构化数据，真正参与到业务分析和决策之中。在 BUILD 2025 的这场技术分享中， Snowflake 产品经理 Jessie Felix 以 《非结构化数据的转化：从复杂挑战到竞争优势》 为主题，系统讲解了 AI SQL 如何成为连接非结构化数据与企业分析体系的关键能力。

title_i18n.zh: 从复杂挑战到竞争优势：AI SQL 如何重塑非结构化数据的价值边界
title_i18n.en: From Complex Challenges to Competitive Edge: How AI SQL Redefines the Value Boundaries of Unstructured Data
title_i18n.es: De desafíos complejos a ventajas competitivas: cómo AI SQL redefine los límites de valor de los datos no estructurados.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 在生成式 AI 快速走向工程化落地的背景下，企业真正面临的挑战，已不再是有没有数据，而是如何让长期被忽视的非结构化数据，真正参与到业务分析和决策之中。在 BUILD 2025 的这场技术分享中， Snowflake 产品经理 Jessie Felix 以 《非结构化数据的转化：从复杂挑战到竞争优势》 为主题，系统讲解了 AI SQL 如何成为连接非结构化数据与企业分析体系的关键能力。
excerpt_i18n.en: Amid the rapid engineering implementation of generative AI, the real challenge for enterprises is no longer the lack of data, but how to effectively integrate long-neglected unstructured data into business analysis and decision-making. At BUILD 2025, Snowflake Product Manager Jessie Felix delivered a technical presentation titled "Transforming Unstructured Data: From Complex Challenges to Competitive Advantage," systematically explaining how AI SQL serves as a key capability bridging unstructured data and corporate analytical systems.
excerpt_i18n.es: En el contexto de la rápida implementación de la IA generativa, el verdadero desafío para las empresas ya no es la falta de datos, sino cómo involucrar los datos no estructurados, largamente ignorados, en el análisis empresarial y la toma de decisiones. En esta sesión técnica de BUILD 2025, Jessie Felix, gerente de producto de Snowflake, presentó "La transformación de los datos no estructurados: de desafío complejo a ventaja competitiva", explicando sistemáticamente cómo AI SQL se convierte en una capacidad clave para conectar los datos no estructurados con los sistemas de análisis empresarial.
